title: Evolving webvise into a Custom Software and AI Systems Platform
excerpt: webvise.io is no longer just a portfolio site. It is a production Next.js platform for positioning services, publishing multilingual content, showcasing product surfaces, and routing qualified project conversations.
challenge: The first version of webvise explained a web development practice. The current business is broader: custom internal tools, dashboards, AI-assisted workflows, MVPs, migrations, and ongoing support. The site had to catch up without becoming a generic agency brochure. It needed to make the operating model visible, connect service pages to proof, keep multilingual content maintainable, and give visitors a clear path from research to a scoped project conversation.
solution: The site was reworked into a product-led marketing system. The homepage now centers one grouped service hierarchy, selected interface work, scope, proof, and support instead of a static portfolio narrative. Case studies and service pages share structured content, localized routing, and reusable proof sections, while the engineering workflow stays AI-native on a modern Next.js stack. The result is a public surface that can change as the business changes: new offers, articles, screenshots, and proof can move through one production codebase instead of being patched into a fragile marketing site.
